title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 84
paragraphs: The body of Mardonius, however, had disappeared on the day after the battle, taken by whom I cannot say for certain; but I have heard the names of many men from various cities who are said to have buried Mardonius, and I know that many received gifts from Artontes son of Mardonius for having done this. Who it was, though, who took up and buried the body of Mardonius, I cannot discover for certain; but Dionysophanes, an Ephesian, is reported with some plausibility to have been the one who buried Mardonius.
